mission.paragraph_1: The Paediatric Interest Group (PIG) is a student-led organisation dedicated to fostering interest and excellence in paediatric medicine among medical students. We bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and clinical practice through hands-on training, educational workshops, and community outreach focused on child health. this is a test
mission.paragraph_2: PIG equips students with essential clinical skills, promotes patient-centred paediatric care, and creates opportunities for leadership, mentorship, and professional development — preparing students for clinical clerkships while making a meaningful impact in the community.
